points.title: 童年与青年时期
points.description: 1840年，埃米尔·左拉出生于巴黎。他的父亲是意大利裔工程师，母亲是法国人。左拉7岁时父亲去世，家庭陷入贫困。这段经历深刻影响了他后来的创作，使他始终关注社会底层人民的生活。1857年，左拉中学毕业，因家境贫困无法继续深造，开始工作谋生。这段时期他经历了各种底层工作，包括在海关当职员，这些经历为他后来的现实主义创作提供了丰富素材。
points.descriptionEn: Émile Zola was born in Paris in 1840. His father was an Italian engineer and his mother was French. When Zola was seven, his father died, plunging the family into poverty. This experience profoundly influenced his later works, as he consistently focused on the lives of the lower classes. In 1857, Zola graduated from secondary school but could not continue his education due to financial constraints, forcing him to work for a living. During this period, he experienced various jobs, including working as a clerk in a customs office, experiences that provided rich material for his later realist writings.

points.title: 文学起步与自然主义宣言
points.description: 1857年，左拉进入阿歇特出版社工作，开始接触文学界。他在此期间结识了保罗·塞尚等艺术家，并开始发表文学评论。1862年，左拉发表了他的第一部小说《克洛德的忏悔》，标志着其文学创作的开始。这一时期，左拉开始发展他的自然主义文学理论，强调科学方法在文学中的应用，主张文学应客观反映现实，尤其是社会底层的生活。他的《自然主义小说家》(1880)成为自然主义文学的重要理论著作。
points.descriptionEn: In 1857, Zola joined the publishing house of Hachette, where he began to engage with the literary world. During this time, he befriended artists like Paul Cézanne and began publishing literary criticism. In 1862, Zola published his first novel, 'La Confession de Claude,' marking the beginning of his literary career. During this period, Zola began developing his theory of naturalist literature, emphasizing the application of scientific methods to literature and advocating for objective reflection of reality, particularly the lives of the lower classes. His 'The Novelists of Naturalism' (1880) became an important theoretical work for naturalist literature.

points.title: 《卢贡-马卡尔家族》系列创作
points.description: 1865年，左拉开始创作他最著名的系列小说《卢贡-马卡尔家族》，计划通过二十部小说全面描绘法兰西第二帝国时期的社会全景。这一系列包括《娜娜》《萌芽》《酒店》等经典作品，采用遗传决定论和社会环境决定论的方法，展现不同社会阶层的生活。左拉在这一时期确立了自然主义文学大师的地位，他的作品以大胆的社会批判和细致的心理描写著称。这一系列创作持续了近三十年，成为法国文学史上最重要的系列作品之一。
points.descriptionEn: In 1865, Zola began writing his most famous series of novels, 'Les Rougon-Macquart,' planning to comprehensively depict the panorama of French society during the Second Empire through twenty novels. This series includes masterpieces such as 'Nana,' 'Germinal,' and 'The Belly of Paris.' Using methods of genetic determinism and environmental determinism, Zola portrayed the lives of different social classes. During this period, Zola established himself as a master of naturalist literature, known for his bold social criticism and detailed psychological descriptions. This series of works continued for nearly thirty years, becoming one of the most important series in French literary history.

points.title: 德雷福斯事件中的正义捍卫者
points.titleEn: Defender of Justice in the Dreyfus Affair
points.description: 1894年，法国犹太军官阿尔弗雷德·德雷福斯被错误地指控叛国并被判处终身监禁。左拉在深入调查后，于1898年1月13日在《费加罗报》上发表著名公开信《我控诉！》，揭露军方掩盖真相的行为。这篇檄文引发了巨大社会震动，左拉因此被起诉并被迫流亡英国。尽管面临巨大压力，左拉坚持为德雷福斯辩护，最终促使案件重审，德雷福斯获得平反。这一事件使左拉成为知识分子的良心象征，也体现了他对社会正义的坚定追求。
points.descriptionEn: In 1894, French Jewish officer Alfred Dreyfus was wrongly accused of treason and sentenced to life imprisonment. After thorough investigation, Zola published his famous open letter 'J'accuse!' in the newspaper 'Le Figaro' on January 13, 1898, exposing the military's cover-up of the truth. This inflammatory article caused tremendous social upheaval, and Zola was prosecuted and forced into exile in England. Despite facing immense pressure, Zola persisted in defending Dreyfus, eventually leading to the case's reopening and Dreyfus's exoneration. This incident made Zola a symbol of intellectual conscience and demonstrated his unwavering commitment to social justice.

points.title: 晚年创作与意外离世
points.description: 1900年，左拉回到巴黎，继续创作《四福音书》系列，包括《繁殖》《劳动》《真理》和《正义》四部作品，试图描绘人类理想社会的蓝图。1902年9月29日，左拉因家中烟道堵塞导致的一氧化碳中毒意外去世，享年62岁。他的葬礼成为一场大规模的公众示威，数万人参加，抗议政府未能保护这位为正义发声的知识分子。左拉的去世震惊了法国社会，他的遗体最终被移入先贤祠，成为少数获此殊荣的作家之一，彰显了他在法国文化史上的崇高地位。
points.descriptionEn: In 1900, Zola returned to Paris and continued working on his 'Four Gospels' series, including 'Fertility,' 'Labor,' 'Truth,' and 'Justice,' attempting to portray a blueprint for an ideal human society. On September 29, 1902, Zola died unexpectedly from carbon monoxide poisoning caused by a blocked chimney flue at his home, at the age of 62. His funeral became a massive public demonstration, with tens of thousands of people attending to protest the government's failure to protect this intellectual who had spoken out for justice. Zola's death shocked French society, and his remains were eventually transferred to the Panthéon, making him one of the few writers to receive this honor, underscoring his esteemed position in French cultural history.

appraisal.zh: 左拉被公认为法国自然主义文学的奠基人，他以《卢贡-马卡尔家族》将科学方法引入文学，深刻描绘社会各阶层，并在德雷福斯事件中以「我控诉！」挑战权力不公，成为社会良知的象征。也有研究者指出，其自然主义理论过于机械决定论，作品失之悲观宿命，介入事件亦被指情绪化、政治化。但总体而言，他仍是19世纪法国最重要的知识分子之一，其文学与社会影响深远。
appraisal.en: Zola is widely regarded as the founder of French naturalist literature: through the Rougon-Macquart series he applied scientific methods to literature, profoundly depicting all social classes, and in the Dreyfus Affair his 'J'accuse!' challenged injustice, making him a symbol of social conscience. Some researchers note that his naturalist theory was overly mechanical and deterministic, his works excessively pessimistic and fatalistic, and his intervention criticized as emotional and political. Nonetheless, he remains one of the most important intellectuals of 19th-century France, with lasting literary and social influence.

supporter.zh: 左拉被视为法国自然主义文学的奠基人和最伟大的代表。他通过《卢贡-马卡尔家族》系列作品，开创了文学创作的新方法，将科学方法应用于文学，客观而深刻地描绘了法国社会各阶层的生活。他最为人称道的是在德雷福斯事件中挺身而出，以知识分子的良知和勇气挑战权力不公，成为正义的象征。左拉的作品不仅具有极高的文学价值，更蕴含着强烈的社会批判精神，为后来的现实主义文学发展奠定了基础。
supporter.en: Zola is regarded as the founder and greatest representative of French naturalist literature. Through his 'Rougon-Macquart' series, he pioneered a new approach to literary creation, applying scientific methods to literature to objectively and profoundly depict the lives of all social classes in France. Most admirably, he stood up during the Dreyfus Affair, challenging injustice with the conscience and courage of an intellectual, becoming a symbol of justice. Zola's works not only possess high literary value but also contain strong social criticism, laying the foundation for the development of later realist literature.

critic.zh: 批评者认为左拉的自然主义理论过于机械和决定论，忽视了人的自由意志和道德选择。他的作品常被指责为过于悲观和宿命论，将人物完全视为环境和遗传的产物。此外，左拉在德雷福斯事件中的介入也被一些人批评为过于情绪化和政治化，认为他利用自己的声望干预司法。他的写作风格也受到批评，认为某些描写过于露骨和煽情，缺乏艺术克制。
critic.en: Critics argue that Zola's naturalist theory is overly mechanical and deterministic, neglecting human free will and moral choice. His works are often criticized for being excessively pessimistic and fatalistic, portraying characters merely as products of environment and heredity. Additionally, Zola's involvement in the Dreyfus Affair has been criticized by some as overly emotional and political, accusing him of using his fame to interfere in the judicial process. His writing style has also been criticized for being too explicit and sensational, lacking artistic restraint.

objective.zh: 在历史学界和流行文化中，左拉被定义为19世纪法国最重要的知识分子之一，是文学革新者和社会正义的象征。他的自然主义理论虽然存在争议，但极大地拓展了文学的表现范围和深度。德雷福斯事件中的'我控诉！'已成为知识分子介入公共事务的经典范例。左拉的形象超越了单纯的文学家，成为社会良知和道德勇气的化身，影响了后世无数知识分子和艺术家。他的作品至今仍被广泛研究和阅读，是法国文学和世界文学的重要组成部分。
objective.en: In historical scholarship and popular culture, Zola is defined as one of the most important intellectuals of 19th-century France, a literary innovator and symbol of social justice. Although his naturalist theory is controversial, it greatly expanded the scope and depth of literary expression. His 'J'accuse!' in the Dreyfus Affair has become a classic example of intellectual engagement in public affairs. Zola's image transcends that of a mere literary figure; he embodies social conscience and moral courage, influencing countless intellectuals and artists throughout history. His works continue to be widely studied and read, forming an essential part of French and world literature.

self.zh: 我的作品是一部关于19世纪法国社会的完整历史，从皇帝到洗衣妇，无所不包。
self.en: My work is the natural and social history of a family under the Second Empire, from the emperor to the laundress, nothing is left out.
